# Source
Excitation Signal

- Voiced
	- Periodic impulse train
	- Quasi-periodic glottal pulses
- Unvoiced
	- White noise
	- Broad-band noise
	- Typically Gaussian

# Filter
- Time-varying linear filter
- Poles & zeroes
	- All-pole for LP

Speech is a convolution of the two (in $t$)
